title: Irina Chuchkina (Fintech GTM advisor) — 'Let's defy the financial gravity, together' (81 likes)
summary: Irina Chuchkina — Fintech GTM advisor — publishes the highest-engagement Startup Leap Day Zero recap of the week (81 likes, 6 comments). Frames Incorruptible as the successor thesis to The Lean Startup: it's not enough to teach founders how to become successful; we also need to teach them to think long-term and build companies that are humane. Closes with a call to action: defy the financial gravity, together.
blockquote: Incorruptible is a book that gives you hope and encouragement to keep fighting for your principles, for the intention you had when you started a new business or a new project. It reminds you that it is possible to stand by your convictions, even when doing so is difficult, and to build organisations that create lasting value without compromising the things that matter. Because too many customers were let down and too companies were murdered in the name of profit. … Let's defy the financial gravity, together.
